dedupe_keys.name: hong kong planning department open data 3d photo realistic model land utilisation statutory plans

description: Hong Kong's Planning Department lists its open datasets on one page, most of them spatial. For the built environment they include a 3D photo-realistic model of the territory, land utilisation statistics and raster grids, digital planning data of statutory plans and regulated areas, boundaries of new towns and tertiary planning units, the 2021-based territorial population and employment data matrix and population distribution projections for 2023 to 2031, site wind availability data, strategic viewing points, a landscape character map, a profile of brownfield sites in the New Territories and area assessments of industrial land. Planning applications, statutory plans gazetted and enforcement cases of the Town Planning Board are also listed, with cross-boundary travel and business establishment surveys. Coverage: Hong Kong. Access: dataset pages linked from the list and the Statutory Planning Portal, free. Licence: not stated on the page read. Caveats: dataset pages were not opened one by one, so formats and dates vary and are not recorded here. Simulation uses are 3D city geometry, land use and projected population for urban climate, wind and planning models and digital twins. Related records: PLATEAU and the Singapore URA data service for comparable Asian city data.
licence: not stated (no licence or terms statement on the provider pages read on 2026-09-28)
